source.title: Lost Heirloom
source.description:
Before the plague turned me, I was a merchant of some importance in Andorhal. The town likely interred my former wealth and family records in Sorrow Hill Crypt when they thought me gone.

Would you be kind enough to retrieve my possessions from the crypt and return them to me?
source.objective: Retrieve the heirlooms from Sorrow Hill Crypt in Western Plaguelands, then return to Dietrich Praice in Orgrimmar.
source.progress: Have you returned from the Plaguelands?
source.completion: Thank you, <name>. You say you found a journal?
